problem: Every table should start with a caption.
recommend: To add a missing caption, open "01_general.html" in MS Word, find the "References" tab at the top of the window, click on the "Insert Caption" button, set the "Label" option to "Table" and fill the content of your "Caption" (e.g. "**Table 1:** Some short but accurate data description.").
prev_elem: **Manuscripts should be written and submitted specifically in a \`.docx\` file format.** This is the default file extension produced by the most common word processing software – Microsoft Word. Other file formats, like \`.pages\` created in Apple Pages or \`.gdoc\` saved from Google Doc will *not* work. In the case of manuscripts written in those unsupported file formats input files should be first transformed to \`.docx\` in order to submit them to the platform.
